title: Horse holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d4254a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 28 Q60 40 65 48 Q68 55 64 65' stroke='#e8c840' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>

  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='18' rx='12' ry='14' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='13' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffb0bf' opacity='0.6'/>
  <polygon points='62,32 59,35 65,35' fill='#d4254a'/>

  <!-- Horse body -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='62' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#c47a3a'/>

  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='24' y='72' width='5' height='18' rx='2' fill='#a8622a'/>
  <rect x='32' y='72' width='5' height='18' rx='2' fill='#a8622a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='72' width='5' height='18' rx='2' fill='#a8622a'/>
  <rect x='50' y='72' width='5' height='18' rx='2' fill='#a8622a'/>

  <rect x='43' y='88' width='7' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#6b3d14'/>
  <rect x='49' y='88' width='7' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#6b3d14'/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M18 58 Q10 52 8 60 Q6 68 12 66' stroke='#8b4f1f' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d='M50 56 Q58 48 54 38' stroke='#c47a3a' stroke-width='10' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='35' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#c47a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='33' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#d98f4e'/>

  <!-- Ear -->
  <polygon points='51,29 53,22 56,28' fill='#a8622a'/>

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='33' r='1.8' fill='#2a1a0a'/>

  <!-- Nostril -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='34' r='1' fill='#8b4f1f'/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M60 37 Q62 38 63 37' stroke='#8b4f1f' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>

  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d='M50 30 Q48 24 52 22 Q54 26 51 32' fill='#7a4517'/>
  <path d='M48 36 Q45 30 47 27 Q50 31 49 37' fill='#7a4517'/>

  <!-- Arm holding string -->
  <path d='M48 58 Q56 54 62 52' stroke='#c47a3a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='51' r='3' fill='#d98f4e'/>
</svg>
